name: RFC 9728: OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata
summary: IETF Proposed Standard defining a metadata document a protected resource publishes (at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) naming its authorization servers and capabilities.
description: The MCP authorization spec requires MCP servers to implement RFC 9728 so clients can discover the authorization server; e.g. https://mcp.squareup.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.
